What the debugger's `TAP` wrote on the tap guest (`tests/guest/tap.asm`), headless, the three taps
put in at its `int 3` and the machine then run 20 retraces (five BIOS ticks).
A row is `r <n> <frame> <line> <ms> <cs> <ip> <data> <mask> <block>`: the frame is the display
frame count since power-on.

count-writes.rows    `TAP W` on `count` with the 4-byte block at `count`: one row per write, each
                     by `w_inc` (0814:011D), `data` the new count, the block the count before it
polled-reads.rows    `TAP R` on `polled`: one row per read, by `r_poll` (0814:0129), 42h in its lane
count-and-pair.tab   `TAP C` over the 8 bytes from `count`: each write's dword, data and mask, by
                     `w_inc` and by `w_pair` (0814:0126)
taplist.txt          `TAPLIST`'s answer at that stop
